brief: Native redesign of a read-only research workbench web app (React 19 + Vite): research-direction overview home, direction and hypothesis research report with verdict evidence, shared library, ordinary runs list and multi-run compare, and experiment analysis reorganised into linked data-visualisation surfaces (lineage tree, progress small multiples, solution-space embeddings incl. 3D, contest) with a persistent program inspector showing code and diffs; dark and light themes, Chinese-first CJK typography, desktop-first and fully readable on phones; award-level visual and interaction craft

command: const fs = require('node:fs'), path = require('node:path'), { createRequire } = require('node:module'), { pathToFileURL } = require('node:url'); const fail = (error) => { console.error(String(error?.message ?? error).replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ')); process.exitCode = 1; }; try { let pkg; try { pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); } catch { throw new Error('Cannot read the target project package.json'); } const pin = pkg.dependencies?.d3 ?? pkg.devDependencies?.d3; if (typeof pin !== 'string' || !/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?(?:\+[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$/.test(pin)) throw new Error('Declare an exact d3 version in the target package.json'); const local = path.resolve('node_modules/d3'); let installed; try { installed = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(local, 'package.json'), 'utf8')); } catch { throw new Error('Cannot resolve the d3 package of the target project at node_modules/d3'); } if (installed.name !== 'd3') throw new Error('node_modules/d3 is not the d3 package'); if (pin !== installed.version) throw new Error('d3 version mismatch: declared ' + pin + ', installed ' + installed.version); if (typeof pkg.scripts?.dev !== 'string' || !pkg.scripts.dev.trim()) throw new Error('Define the target project scripts.dev before npm run dev'); const entry = fs.realpathSync(createRequire(path.resolve('package.json')).resolve('d3')); const inside = path.relative(fs.realpathSync(local), entry); if (!inside || inside.startsWith('..') || path.isAbsolute(inside)) throw new Error('d3 resolved outside node_modules/d3: ' + entry); import(pathToFileURL(entry).href).then((d3) => { if (typeof d3.select !== 'function') throw new Error('The installed d3 package does not export select'); console.log('d3=' + installed.version); }).catch(fail); } catch (error) { fail(error); }
